title: File:Artificial sweetener in tablets.jpg
desc: Sweetener based on sodium cyclamate and saccharine in form of tablets. Ruler is above to understand the size of tablets. One pill, according to the manufacturer, feels like 1 teaspoon of sugar. Easily dissolves in water, giving it a sweet taste.

title: File:Circa 1950s Soetinetter artificial sweetener small wooden box Sweden.jpg
desc: Circa 1950s Swedish Sötinetter artificial sweetener in a small wooden box. The lid states that the sweetener is 450 times sweeter than sugar, that one tablet corresponds to two sugar cubes and four tablets to 25 g of sugar, and that the box originally contained approximately 500 tablets.
